plugin.description: Shows the current weather and the wind for a place on a key, from Open-Meteo.
plugin.requirements: An internet connection. No account or API key.

Weather.description: Shows the current weather as an icon with the temperature below it. It refreshes itself every few minutes; pressing the key fetches right away. The place is given as coordinates, not as a city name.

lat.description: Latitude of the place, as text. Without it the key shows an error.

lon.description: Longitude of the place, as text.

WindDirection.description: Shows where the wind is blowing: an arrow turned into the wind's direction, with the wind speed below it. It refreshes itself; pressing the key fetches right away.

lat.description: Latitude of the place, as text.

lon.description: Longitude of the place, as text.
